column2: タイイツの恩恵を以って、我が國の防衛は\n強固なものになる、ククッ
column3: The Tai-itsu Satellite has made our country's defenses a force to be reckoned with.

column2: 今後益々の我々への敬意を忘れてくれるなよ\nクククク…
column3: Don't forget to show some respect, now. *chuckle*

column2: おねだり男児

column2: ヘータイさんなら　しってるかな？
column3: Does the soldier know?

column2: 知ってるでしょうよ
column3: Of course he does, honey.

column2: 騒ぎ起こした、張本人さんたちなんだからさ
column3: After all, they're the ones responsible.

column2: 暇そうなオッサン
column3: Bored-Looking Man

column2: 陸軍の連中、あんなバカでけぇもんを\nいきなり打ち上げやがって！
column3: What the hell is the Army thinking, launching that huge thing!?

column2: 今日は一日中寝てようと思ってたのに、\nビビって気が失せちまったよ！
column3: I was gonna take a nap for the day, but I was too scared.

column2: 暇そうなオッサン
column3: Bored-Looking Man

column2: 今月ピンチだったし……\n正直、遊ぶ金なんてないのよ
column3: My wallet's feeling the pinch this month. I don't have any money to be fooling around.

column2: あのバカでけぇ打ち上げ、丁度よかったのかもな…
column3: Thank goodness they launched that thing...

column2: やぶ睨みの陸軍兵
column3: Squinting Army Soldier

column2: この町の住人は聞き分けがよくて助かる
column3: Good thing the townspeople here are reasonable.

column2: 貴重な弾薬を暴動鎮圧に使わず済んだからな
column3: Don't have to waste valuable riot shells on 'em.

column2: 耳年増な女性
column3: Knowledgeable Young Lady

column2: 伽耶さんもご無事なら、さっきのやつ見てるだろうねぇ
column3: If Kaya's all right, she must have seen that thing that launched.

column2: 同じ帝都の空の下でさ……
column3: We're all under the same sky...

column3: Fumiko

column3: I'm so angry, Yaeko! I don't want some soldier calling me chubby!

column2: 八重子
column3: Yaeko

column2: なら、見返してやりましょうよ
column3: Come on, then let's teach them a lesson!

column2: 文子
column3: Fumiko

column3: You're right! This time, I'm serious! I'm going on a diet... next month!

column3: Yaeko

column2: え？
column3: ...Huh?

column2: 増援の陸軍兵
column3: Army Reinforcement

column2: …さて 打ち上げも無事済んだし
column3: Looks like the launch was a success.

column2: 増援組は、そろそろ帰りますかね
column3: They should be pulling us reinforcement soldiers out soon, then.

column2: 通りすがりの配達夫
column3: Passing Deliveryman

column2: あちこちに陸軍が出動してるっていうから、\nどんな厄介事かと思えば…
column3: I was expecting some trouble with all these Army soldiers around.

column2: ……さっき打ちあがった球だけ？\nな、なんか拍子抜けだよなぁ
column3: And it ended up just being about that ball they launched? Kind of disappointing...

column3: ПЕРЕВОД НА АНГЛИЙСКИЙ

column2: 伽耶、変に強情なとこあるから…\n責任感が強すぎるのよ…あの子\n<lips_stop>
column3: Kaya can be so bull-headed. She's way too responsible for her own good.\n<lips_stop>

column2: ライドウさんのもとを去ったのも、\n鬼憑き、自分でなんとかしようって…\n<lips_stop>
column3: She probably changed her mind about getting your help so she could handle the possession on her own...\n<lips_stop>

column3: Yeah, that has to be it...\n<lips_stop>

column2: …探偵の捜索を振り切ってまで、\n何をしたいのかしらね…？
column3: What is she doing out there? Why is she dodging the police?

column3: Easygoing Servant

column3: What was that racket?

column2: あぁ、二階の連中か\n転んだとかしちゃったんだろうね
column3: Ah, the people in the upstairs rooms. I suppose one of them tripped and fell.

column3: Miss Kaya was looking for the same crystal that foreigner was babbling about!?\n<lips_stop>

column3: I beg of you, please save Miss Kaya. Not just for this family, but for everyone in the Capital.\n<lips_stop>

column2: 血眼の使用人
column3: Horrified Servant

column3: Aaargh! There's a terrible pressure on my head...

column3: It's not just a normal headache. It's like... someone's gaze, drilling into my soul...

column2: 血眼の使用人
column3: Horrified Servant

column2: 頭を押さえつけられてる感じが…\n頭痛なんて単純なもんじゃない…
column3: Aaargh! It feels like my head is in a vice. It's no ordinary headache...

column3: The space that the underground voice was talking about was... th-the sky?

column3: Gossipy Servant

column3: Inner Voice

column3: I'm desperate to see what's going on out there! I'm so curious, I can't even eat.<COLOR 0>

column3: Caustic Servant

column2: 陸軍の仕業なのかい？　新兵器の実験かなんかかい？
column3: Is the Army up to more tricks? Are they testing a new weapon or something?

column3: Police on Patrol

column2: あんなの騒音公害だろ、事前告知もなかったし
column3: What the hell are they doing out there? It's noise pollution! The police weren't notified of this!

column2: でも、今は戒厳令が出ちゃってるし…\nあいつらの言うことに逆らえないんだ…
column3: But it's not like we can raise a stink. We're under martial law now, so they call the shots.

column2: 中条区所轄の巡査
column3: Police on Patrol

column2: たーまやー！　かーぎやー！\n……なんて言うと思うか！？
column3: The hell are you talking about!? You think I care about that!?

column2: 軍管轄の催しだからってな！\n事前告知とか、筋通してやれよな！
column3: Noise pollution is a pet peeve of mine, especially when there's no advance notice!

column2: 鼻で笑う陸軍兵
column3: Sneering Soldier

column2: 最前線で常に死と隣り合わせの我々に比べたら\n警察部など…
column3: Compared to soldiers like us who share trenches with death on the battlefield, police are...

column2: …あそこにいる巡査、俺なら視線だけで殺せる
column3: ...Well, you see that policeman right there? I could kill him just by staring at him funny.

column2: 遠い目をした老紳士
column3: Reminiscing Gentleman

column2: さっき飛んで行ったやつ…私が君くらいの頃、\n見たことが……
column3: That thing that flew up into the sky... I saw something like that when I was your age.

column2: 爆弾か？　いやちがうな…\n胸騒ぎがするんだ…とても嫌な感じだ
column3: Was it a bomb? No... I have a feeling that something terrible is about to happen.

column2: 実直そうな鉄道員
column3: Honest-Looking Railroad Worker

column2: あんな光の球のために、路面電車の運転を\n差し止めたのか！？　陸軍の連中は！
column3: The Army stopped all streetcar movement because of that lousy ball they sent up!?

column2: 自分らの都合だけで勝手なことを！\n路面電車は皆の足なのに！！
column3: Why would they do such a thing? The streetcars are one of our most important transit methods!

column2: 銀ブラ中の爺さん
column3: Strolling Old Man

column2: あぁ気分が悪いわい、さっき球っころ見たせいかの
column3: I feel a mite peculiar... It must be that sphere they launched, I'd wager.

column2: こんな日は早々に帰った方がいいじゃろうて
column3: Guess I'll stroll back home early to get some rest.

column2: 瞬きをしない陸軍兵
column3: Unblinking Soldier

column2: 宗像閣下の展望は開けている\n我々の想像もつかないほどにな
column3: Major General Munakata has a plan to strengthen our nation. We couldn't even begin to comprehend it.

column2: 衛星タイイツ打ち上げも、宗像閣下の展望の\nほんの一部に相違ない
column3: The Tai-itsu Satellite must be another part of the General's plan.

column2: 真昼間から花火なんて、確かに感心できないけど
column3: I can't condone setting off fireworks in broad daylight, but...

column3: I do admire the resolve of whoever set them off. Something so futile takes dedication.

column2: 花火上げるなら、事前に伝えてよね
column3: If one must set off fireworks, there is a proper time and place.

column2: モダンな花火だったわ、負けたわ
column3: Oh, they were some sort of modern fireworks? Well then, carry on.

column3: Kanto Haguro Punk

column3: Why don't ya take a look in the mirror before speakin' up? Runt like you oughta know his place.

column3: If you're gonna complain, at least show some respect. You're bringin' shame to that emblem on your hat.

column3: This haori isn't just for looks. It's proof of resolve for the man in charge.\n<lips_stop>

column3: If they come at us, we'll respond with force. We ain't bright enough to know how to hold back, y'know.\n<lips_stop>

column3: I heard a big commotion coming from outside... That definitely sounded like the boss.

column2: 名前あげたくて兄ぃにカラむ奴は多い\nこれも有名税ってやつだよな
column3: Lots of punks try to make their bones by beating him. That's the price of being famous.

column2: 関東羽黒組の幹部補佐
column3: Kanto Haguro Officer

column2: 兄ぃは、喧嘩で拳を使わねぇのよ\n腕はいつも着物の中で組んでてな
column3: Boss never uses his fists. He keeps his arms folded under his kimono at all times.

column2: それでも今まで負け無しってんだから\n化けモンだよ、あの人
column3: People try, but to this day, he's never lost a fight. He's a beast.

column3: Spineless Army Soldier

column2: フ、フハ、フハハハハ！\n見ろ！　タイイツ打ち上げ成功だ！
column3: Ha... Hahahaha! Look! The launch of the Tai-itsu Satellite was a success!
column4: Ха-ха-ха! Посмотрите! Запуск спутника «Тай-ицу» был произведён успешно!

column2: チンピラ風情が！\nこの屈辱、万倍にして返してやるからな！
column3: You punks! Now I'm going to get my revenge for what you did!
column4: А теперь я отомщу за то что вы сделали со мной, жалкое вы хулиганьё!

column2: 関東羽黒組の三下
column3: Kanto Haguro Punk

column2: 任侠道一筋、関東羽黒組の看板持ち捕まえて\nチンピラときたか！
column3: Is he callin' our leader—Fukagawa-cho's number one defender of chivalry—a punk!?

column2: 士官学校じゃ、言葉の選び方ってやつ\n教えてもらえんのかねぇ
column3: Guess they don't teach ya how to mind your manners in military school.

column2: ボケ好きの爺さん
column3: Kooky Old Man

column2: ワシの軍役時代も反重力推進装置の\n試験運用をやっとったな……
column3: Back in my military days, I was testing a combustion engine to push back against gravity.

column2: 反重力推進装置ってのはモダンに言うと…\nなんじゃったかのぅ…なんとかケット？
column3: What do they call them nowadays...? Rookets? Rockos?

column3: Working Man

column2: おいおい！　なんだったんだ？\nさっき飛び上がってった丸いのは！？
column3: What the hell was that!? Some fiery ball just flew up into the air!

column2: う、うちの坊主は…うちの坊主は大丈夫か…！？
column3: M-My boy... My boy's all right, isn't he!?

column3: Inner Voice

column3: When you've got your heart set on someone, looks don't matter, do they?

column2: 生まれてしまったからには、狩猟民族よ
column3: We're all born hunters.

column2: 中心で生きる者

column3: For some reason, I can't get you off my mind!

column2: こっそり後をつけてぇ、弱みを握り潰すぅ！
column3: I just want to sneak up from behind and snatch you up!

column3: Woman with a Past

column3: You're probably too young to have seen a loved one die right before your eyes.

column3: Sometimes... I get jealous of the close bond men are able to have, like my brother and Mr. Kiyoshi.\n<lips_stop>

column2: 何があっても大丈夫よきっと、\n鳴海さんには貴方がいるもの\n<lips_stop>
column3: Everything will be fine. Mr. Narumi has you behind him.\n<lips_stop>

column2: 感情の豊かな遊女
column3: Emotive Courtesan

column2: いっぱい失敗した、きっとこれからもする
column3: I've made a lot of mistakes, and I'm sure I'll make plenty more.

column2: 失敗していい生き物なんて、人間ぐらいだよね？
column3: But if there's any creature on the planet that should have the freedom to make mistakes, it's humans, right?

column3: Frequent Customer

column3: You may be able to lift the weight of your troubles for a little while...

column2: けど、一生ついてまわるもんだから、\nケリつけるのは本人がやらんといかん
column3: But it'll follow you around your entire life. The only one who can deal with it is you.

column3: Honestly, it was possible that I could've ended up just like Munakata.\n<lips_stop>

column2: …でも、俺は違った\nライドウ、お前に出会えた\n<lips_stop>
column3: But... I didn't. And it's because of you, Raidou.\n<lips_stop>

column2: お前に出会って、気づかされたよ\n<lips_stop>
column3: Meeting you made me realize something.\n<lips_stop>

column2: すべての真実を知った気になって、\n勝手に絶望していただけだと\n<lips_stop>
column3: I used to think that grim reality was the only truth in the world.\n<lips_stop>

column2:
お前のひたむきな姿に触れて、
そういう人間がいるって一番大切な真実を、
俺はすっかり見落としていたという事を…
<lips_stop>
column3: But seeing you pressing on no matter what... Just knowing that there are people like you out there opened my eyes.\n<lips_stop>

column2: この世界には真実がいくつもある\n人によって一番大切なものが違う\n<lips_stop>
column3: There's more than just one truth. Everyone has their <IT_S>own<IT_E> truth.\n<lips_stop>

column2: 俺は、依頼人にとって一番大切な真実を\n見つけ出すため、探偵をやっている\n<lips_stop>
column3: That's why I became a detective in the first place—to help people find <IT_S>theirs<IT_E>.\n<lips_stop>

column2: ゴウト
column3: Gouto

column2: 待て、ライドウ\n化け物が暴れているのは確か港
column3: Wait, Raidou. That monster should be by the ocean.

column2: 反対側の階段を使い、\n自動電話から晴海町へ出よう
column3: Let's take the stairs on the other side and head to Harumi-cho.

column2: 宗像だったもの
column3: Munakata's Shell

column2: ………\n<lips_stop>
＞すでに事切れている\n<lips_stop>
column3: > Munakata is dead...

column2: 鳴海
column3: Narumi

column2: …宗像さんも、そのスクナヒコナって悪魔も\n自分に正直すぎたよ、バカがつくほどな\n<lips_stop>
column3: Both Munakata and Sukuna-Hikona held onto their beliefs until the very end.\n<lips_stop>

column2: …けど、周りを気遣えない力の行使は、\nダダこねてるのと変わりはしない\n<lips_stop>
column3: But acting out and ignoring the consequences is like a kid throwing a tantrum.\n<lips_stop>

column2: 彼らには悪いが、あの化け物をこのままにはできない\n行こう、ライドウ\n<lips_stop>
column3: No matter what reasons they had, they unleashed an actual monster.\n<lips_stop>

column2: 鳴海
column3: Narumi

column2: 神だなんだの復讐やら、一握りの奴らの都合やら…\n<lips_stop>
column3: I don't care if it's a grudge or for "order" or what...\n<lips_stop>

column2: そんなもんで、皆が振り回されていいわけがない\n<lips_stop>
column3: The military can't just do whatever they want!\n<lips_stop>

column2: 宗像さん、待っててくれ、弔いは必ずする\n<lips_stop>
column3: Munakata... You'll be able to rest in peace soon.\n<lips_stop>
